exact: negative regulation by symbiont of host cholinergic synaptic transmission

definition: A process in which a symbiont inhibits or disrupts the normal execution of cholinergic synaptic transmission, communication from a neuron to a target (neuron, muscle, or secretory cell) across a synapse via the neurotransmitter choline, in its host organism.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host cholinergic synaptic transmission
